slides.title: Recurring connections and payment methods
slides.subtitle: Recurring-capable connections across HBO Max's Asia Pacific, European and Latin American markets

slides.kicker: WHAT COUNTS AS RECURRING IN THIS DECK
slides.headline: Only methods that Yuno can bill again without the subscriber present are shown; one-time methods are left out.

items.title: Subscriptions engine
items.body: Yuno bills on the schedule you set: cards, PayPal (billing agreement) and Pix Automático in Brazil, all on a vaulted token.

items.title: Stored credentials
items.body: Cards plus Apple Pay and Google Pay tokens, with the network transaction id stored on the token so renewals can be routed or retried on any connected provider.

items.title: Enrollable local methods
items.body: A vaulted token after a one-time consent: SEPA, Bacs, Autogiro, Betalingsservice, BECS and PAD direct debits, iDEAL, Bancontact, Klarna, Afterpay, TWINT, Revolut Pay, NuPay, Daviplata, Nequi, Mercado Pago Wallet, Yape, Smart PIX, AstroPay, GCash, DANA, GoPay, ShopeePay and Touch 'n Go.

items.title: One-time methods
items.body: Cash and vouchers, QR codes, one-shot bank transfers and wallets without an enrollment flow (BLIK, Swish, MobilePay, OXXO, one-time Pix and similar).

items.title: How to read the country slides
items.body: Live = built and available through Yuno for that country; every live card processor supports recurring card billing. Outlined chips = integration code exists but y.uno/integrations does not list the provider yet (integrated, not live). Local methods appear only where Yuno's catalog has an enrollment or recurring flow.

slides.bar: Basis: docs.y.uno subscriptions, stored credentials and enrollment pages, Yuno's catalog of enrollment types and integration repo inventory, read on 22 October 2026.
slides.notes: Sources: y.uno/integrations directory (export of 14 Oct 2026), docs.y.uno Payment Type list and API enums (22 Oct 2026), Yuno integration code scan and repo inventory (Caio Freitas, payment-method-coverage-gaps, 14 Oct 2026, re-read 22 Oct); Payments Concierge integration matrix for the Latin American markets; Apple Pay availability per Apple (22 Oct 2026). Live = the connection is built and available to process through Yuno for this country; method activation is set per merchant.
